messages:
carmen: Quick sync  we need a succinct design for partner SIEM exports + forensic snapshots for audit. Draft: infra traces=30d, auth/privilege=180d, regulated tenants auth=365d. Partner feed = metadata-only, no PII, 90d retention.

lee: sounds right. define PII fields we strip: user_email, user_name, phone, client_ip (unless internal). keep hashed user_id for correlation.

max: KMS model: one CMK per compliance boundary, envelope encryption for snapshots, key policy only allows snapshot-service + kms-ops role. partners never see keys.

carmen: incident flow idea: on ticket >=P2 auto-snapshot query by trace/session id, upload -> s3://forensics/<ticket>.tar.gz, KMS:Encrypt with CMK, create presigned URL (48h) and grant ephemeral "forensic-analyst" role for access. after 48h role revoked; artifact remains locked.

lee: enforce object-lock where available and emit audit events for snapshot.create, presign.create, role.grant, role.revoke. RBAC change process: GH PR -> sec approval -> SCIM provision -> TTL.

max: for partner SIEM pipeline add transform:
```
- drop: payload.user_email, payload.user_name, payload.phone
- rewrite: payload.user_id => sha256(user_id + salt)
- drop_long_traces: true
```
And use separate bucket from canonical logs.

carmen: action items: max=KMS PoC (due Tue), lee=transform + sample mapping (due Wed), carmen=playbook update and RFC for retention. security-bot: compliance scanner queued.
